Name: GMCM Layered Groups
Author: Meoom
Description:
[size=150][b]GMCM Layered Groups[/b][/size]

Tired of scrolling through [b]hundreds of flat mod entries[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu just to find one setting? This mod turns the messy GMCM list into [b]clean, collapsible folder groups[/b] — automatically organized to match your Mods directory structure. Find any config in seconds, no more endless scrolling.


[line]
[b]The Core Feature[/b]

[b]Automatic Folder Groups — Your Mods Folder Layout, Right Inside GMCM.[/b]

You've already spent time organizing your mods into subfolders under [b]Mods/[/b] (like [b]Core Mods/[/b], [b]Quality of Life/[/b], [b]Content Expansions/[/b], [b]Ridgeside Village/[/b]). Vanilla GMCM ignores that work completely and dumps every single mod into one flat scroll list.

This mod fixes that. It reads your Mods folder hierarchy the moment GMCM opens, then rebuilds the list as [b]nested, collapsible groups that exactly mirror your subdirectories[/b]. Every folder level is supported — if you use nested subfolders, you get nested groups too.

[b]What it solves:[/b]
[list]
[*]✅ No more hunting for the right mod in a flat list of 100+ entries.[/*]
[*]✅ Mods that belong together (by the way [b]you[/b] organized them) stay together.[/*]
[*]✅ If you later re-organize your Mods folder by moving or renaming folders, the GMCM group layout updates automatically next time you open it — no config, no restart.[/*]
[/list]

[line]
[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]Required dependencies[/b] (install these first):
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] — v4.0.0 or newer[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] — v1.6.0 or newer, by [b]spacechase0[/b] (absolutely required)[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Download the ZIP for this mod.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]GMCMLayeredGroups[/b] folder directly into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods/[/b] folder (or any subfolder of Mods — it always scans the entire Mods tree correctly).[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI, open GMCM (cog icon on title screen or in-game menu), and you're done![/*]
[/list]

[line]
[b]How to Use[/b]

[list]
[*]Click any group header line to [b]toggle collapse / expand[/b] it.[/*]
[*]Click any mod name inside a group to open that mod's config panel (same behavior as vanilla GMCM).[/*]
[*]Your Mods folder layout [i]is[/i] the configuration. To change group names / ordering, simply rename or reorder your Mods subfolders.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Best practice note:[/b] To stay safely within Windows / SMAPI file path limits, keep your folder grouping structure to roughly [b]2–3 levels deep[/b]. This mod itself only reads existing folder names and does not create or extend paths — but overly deep nesting with long folder names can cause SMAPI to fail loading those mods regardless of this mod.


[line]
[b]Compatibility[/b]

[b]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/b] — ✅ Tested & fully supported
[b]Windows[/b] — ✅ Fully tested
[b]macOS / Linux[/b] — ✅ Works with standard SMAPI + GMCM installs
[b]Android / iOS[/b] — ❓ Not tested by the author
[b]GMCM versions before 1.6.0[/b] — ⚠️ Not guaranteed — built & tested against GMCM 1.16+, upgrading recommended

[b]Plays well with:[/b]
[list]
[*]Content Patcher and all SMAPI content packs[/*]
[*]Multi-language mod setups (preserves every mod's own manifest display name)[/*]
[*]Mod managers (Vortex, r2modman, SMAPI installer, manual install)[/*]
[*]Large mod lists of 100+ mods[/*]
[/list]

[line]
[b]Change Log[/b]

[b]v1.1.0[/b]

[/list]

[/list]
